description: Live airfares for a trip to or from Seattle (SEA), cheapest first, priced exactly as seatac.co prices them (taxes and fees included, USD). Each result lists the flights, times, stops, fare terms and bags; booking_url opens seatac.co's flight search on the same trip, where the traveler picks the flight and pays. One of origin or destination must be SEA. Rate limited; reuse results instead of re-searching.

destination.description: 3-letter airport code, e.g. LAX or SEA.

origin.description: 3-letter airport code, e.g. SEA or JFK.

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD for a round trip; omit for one way.

name: search_flights
title: Search flights to or from Seattle
